query: I have severe insomnia, intrusive thoughts, compulsive mental loops, anxiety, and executive-function problems. After years of self-medicating, two prescribed medications once made my mind quiet and life tolerable, but I developed an autonomic disorder and was taken off them. A later medication combination left me numb and I had a severe episode of hitting myself. I am now four days into restarting one medication, my focus is improving, but I barely sleep and am considering returning to the recreational substance if my prescriber does not answer. What should I do tonight and how should I think about the conflicting treatment history?
